name: How can I add pantry storage when my San Diego kitchen has no pantry?

mainEntity.name: How can I add pantry storage when my San Diego kitchen has no pantry?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen without a pantry can still gain organized food storage through a tall cabinet, shallow shelving, deep drawers, or a carefully planned cabinet near the refrigerator. Elite Remodeling & Design can assess these options within the existing layout or a larger kitchen remodel. Context: The best location depends on refrigerator-door clearance, traffic paths, wall width, and proximity to food preparation. Very deep shelves may create hidden items unless paired with drawers, bins, or turntables. Key factors: available vertical space; door swings; shelf depth; bulk-buying habits. Practical guidance: Measure the unused areas beside appliances and at the ends of cabinet runs. Keep everyday staples at reachable heights and reserve high shelves for occasional items. Confirm that a new cabinet will not narrow a working aisle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a tall pantry cabinet, shallow shelves, deep drawers, or a cabinet near the refrigerator. First check door swings, aisle width, wall space, and shelf depth; otherwise, added storage may become difficult to reach or obstruct movement.
